0.1.28: Replaced E2EE encryption protocol — now uses server-managed symmetric keys instead of ECDH
Fixed 'Encrypted message' errors on Android and after browser cache clears
Encryption keys are now always available — no more key loss on device changes
Migrated all existing encrypted messages to the new protocol
0.1.27: Fixed reply quotes showing raw encrypted payload instead of decrypted content in E2EE conversations
Reply quotes now correctly decrypt reply_to_content for both DMs and channel messages
Editing a message now updates the reply quote content in real-time for all messages referencing it
Reply quotes now show 'Original message was deleted' when the parent message no longer exists
0.1.26: E2EE is now always enabled for DMs — messages are always encrypted, the disable option has been removed
Fixed messages reverting to 'Message Encrypted' — decryption now works reliably using ECDH key derivation without requiring an explicit 'enabled' flag
Fixed system announcements not appearing without a page refresh — announcements now appear instantly in chat
Fixed announcement notification badge not showing in the DM sidebar
Fixed announcement messages showing blank — the correct message object is now passed to the chat renderer
0.1.25: Added end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for direct messages — all DM messages are now encrypted with keys stored only on your device
E2EE uses elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH) for secure key exchange and AES-256-GCM for message encryption
DM messages are encrypted before sending and decrypted on receipt — the server only sees ciphertext
0.1.24: Fixed bot member list not updating in real-time when a bot joins or leaves a server
Fixed system announcement messages showing empty content — title and body now display correctly
Added markdown formatting support in messages — bold, italic, strikethrough, and underline
0.1.22: Overhauled game detection with 4-layer smart detection engine
Added window title matching — detects games even with unexpected process names
Added Steam library auto-scanning — detects ANY installed Steam game via appmanifest files
Added Unreal Engine / Unity heuristic — catches unknown games by engine process patterns
Expanded curated game database to 200+ titles including ARC Raiders, Monster Hunter Wilds, Marvel Rivals, Silent Hill 2, Avowed, and many more
Intelligent process filtering — ignores 50+ known system/launcher/browser processes
Reduced detection poll interval from 15s to 10s for faster game pickup
Steam library cache with 5-minute TTL to avoid repeated disk scans
0.1.21: Installer now auto-closes running RecoilApp before updating — no more stuck 'Retry' dialog
Uninstaller also force-closes RecoilApp before removing files
0.1.20: Fixed crash on startup — game-detector module was missing from packaged build
Game detection now loads gracefully and won't crash the app if unavailable
0.1.19: Game Activity Detection — automatically detects 200+ popular games and shows what you're playing
Activity settings panel with Auto (game detection) and Custom activity modes
Custom activity persists across sessions — your custom status is restored on login
Detects streaming (OBS, Streamlabs) and listening (Spotify) apps in addition to games
0.1.18: Fixed E2EE messages showing as 'Encrypted message' after page reload — keys now properly decrypt queued messages once loaded
DM notification bubbles now persist across page refreshes
Starting a DM with a friend now immediately shows the conversation in the sidebar
0.1.17: Added multi-file upload support — attach up to 10 files per message with drag & drop, paste, or file picker
Multiple image attachments display in a responsive grid layout
Custom status now expands with text instead of truncating in profile cards
Premium plan limits fully enforced: channels, roles, emojis, webhooks, pins, file size, friend categories, group DM size, custom invites, audit log retention, and more
Plan-aware file size limits: Free 10MB, Premium 50MB, Premium+ 100MB per file
0.1.16: Added Discord-style message search with Ctrl+F shortcut and 12 filter types
Added emoji picker button in the message input bar
Search supports from:, has:, before:, after:, pinned: and more filters
Search results show message previews with avatars and timestamps
0.1.15: Added customizable keyboard shortcuts (Settings → Desktop App → Keyboard Shortcuts)
Ctrl+L instantly locks the app when a PIN or password is configured
Ctrl+Shift+M toggles microphone mute from anywhere in the app
Ctrl+Shift+D toggles audio deafen from anywhere in the app
Keybinds can be changed, cleared, or reset to defaults in Desktop Settings
System and conflicting shortcuts are automatically blocked when recording
0.1.14: Fixed menu bar appearing when pressing ALT key
Images now open in a fullscreen lightbox inside the app instead of a new window
Lightbox supports zoom (scroll/+/-), rotate (R), download, and open in browser
Blocked all same-domain popup windows — everything stays in the main app

Downloads now show a native Save As dialog with the correct filename
Taskbar flashes when a download completes in the background
